notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dCc_c and arm9/CommonModel entries, which took the same route.

_ZN8dCcPos_cD1Ev is the key function: the vtable and the _ZTS/_ZTI records emit from this TU and are licensed deadstrip-data at their configured homes 0x0208e6bc/0x0208e674/0x0208e68c. Unlike the model family, the collision family carries real typeinfo, so the TU compiles with RTTI on.

Init stays a mangled free definition (_ZN8dCcPos_c4InitERK7Vector35Fix12IiES4_jj as extern "C" with scalar parameters): the real signature takes two Fix12<int> by value and wall 6az homes class-typed by-value parameters on the stack. dCcPos_c.h keeps the real declaration for callers; the same pattern ShadowModel::InitModel uses.

The D0 shard's _MSC_VER scaffold is dropped: it existed because two files each defined ~dCcPos_c (D1's real body, D0's spelled-out deleting twin) which MSVC would emit twice. One TU has one ~dCcPos_c(), so there is nothing for the host arm to disambiguate.
